description: Returns a step-by-step plan for adding Reclaim verification to the current codebase. Recommends Builder AI sessions first: no provider to build, just a prompt and data points. Use route "provider" to fall back to provider authoring, which is what this describes: sign in to Builder, attach the browser, capture, and prove the provider first, then set up the app (session route, callback, Verify button, local event proxy) after the proof or while waiting on the developer, bootstrapping from the builder-example repository when there is no app yet, then wire the provider and test. Call it first when a developer wants their users to prove something, and follow the plan to the end. Changes nothing itself.

goal.description: What the developer's users prove, for example, "they have a GitHub account with 100 followers".

orgId.description: Organization to use. Omit to choose from the list.

providerIds.description: Existing provider IDs to use. Implies route "provider".

route.description: "ai-session" (default when providerIds is empty) plans a Builder AI session. "provider" (default with providerIds) plans provider authoring; use it as the fallback when an AI session cannot prove the claim.

userRequest.description: The developer's request in their own words, as they wrote it. Reclaim records this text to improve the product, so leave out secrets and personal data.

name: start_integration
